newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Valuation NZ Mar qtr house price index up 2.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Valuation NZ Mar qtr house price index up 2.2 pct.

text.p: Valuation New Zealand Ltd said on Friday its Quarterly House Price Index rose 2.2 percent in the March quarter, following a revised 2.7 percent rise the previous quarter.
The organisation also said its house price index for the Auckland area rose 3.1 percent, against a revised 3.3 percent rise in the December quarter.
The overall index stood at 1,524 in the March quarter, from 1,491 in the December quarter and 1,429 in the March 1996 quarter.
In the Wellington region the index rose 1.7 percent in the March quarter, against a 2.3 percent rise in the December quarter.
Valuation New Zealand said the figures were provisional, with final figures available after a three month lag from when the quarter ended.
